create.title: New organization
create.description: Creates a production organization with its primary book, accounting periods, root legal entity, built-in roles and default configuration, and invites its first administrator.
create.countryHint: Where the organization is registered. Its root legal entity uses the same country.
create.currencyHint: The functional currency of the organization's books and its root legal entity.
create.adminEmailHint: The first administrator receives a one-time link to set a password. The address must not already sign in to another organization.
create.reasonPlaceholder: Why this organization is being created
create.reasonHint: Recorded with the organization, the administrator and the role assignment in the audit log.
create.required: Complete every field before creating the organization.
create.created: {name} created. A set-password link was sent to {email}.
create.createdLinkOnly: {name} created. Copy the administrator's one-time set-password link now.
create.requestFailed: The organization could not be created.

nav.overviewDescription: Deployment-wide operations, identities, access controls, and delivery evidence.

hub.title: Platform
hub.description: Platform-wide operations, identities, access controls, and delivery evidence.
hub.superAdminsDetail: {count, plural, one {# super administrator} other {# super administrators}}

notice.title: Platform workspace
notice.description: This workspace bypasses organization boundaries for authorized operators. Every access-control mutation is validated and written to the immutable audit trail.

access.title: Cross-org access
access.description: Controlled mappings between login identities and organizations. Super admins do not require grants.
access.empty: No grants yet. Grant access to map a login identity into another organization.
access.searchPlaceholder: Search member, organization, or acting user…

grant.title: Grant cross-organization access
grant.description: Choose the member identity, target organization, and active user whose permissions apply there.
grant.memberHelp: The person's home login identity. This remains the accountable member when they enter another organization.
grant.organizationHelp: The production organization the member will be allowed to enter. Home-organization access is already implicit.
grant.actingUserHelp: The active user record whose roles and permissions apply while the member is operating in the target organization.

users.title: Users
users.description: Production login identities, organization roles, and platform privileges.

mutation.requestFailed: The platform change could not be completed.

users.noGrants: No explicit cross-organization grants. This identity has access to its home organization unless it is a super admin.

tenants.title: Organizations
tenants.description: Every production company, sandbox, and preview environment. Open an organization to enter it as the current workspace.
tenants.productionOnly: Only production organizations can be opened from here.

feedback.title: Issue reporting
feedback.description: Where in-app product reports are filed for this deployment.
feedback.settingsDescription: One destination serves the whole deployment. People can report from any page; reports are generalized to remove personal and company details before an issue is filed.
feedback.tokenHelp: Requires Issues: Read and write (fine-grained) or repo (classic). Leave blank to keep the stored token. When reporting is enabled, saving verifies the token against the repository.
feedback.storedTokenDescription: Removing the token also turns reporting off because reports cannot be filed without credentials. Existing issues are unaffected.

mutations.requestFailed: The platform change could not be completed.

actions.cannotRevokeOwn: You cannot revoke your own super-admin access.
actions.finalSuperAdmin: The final active super administrator cannot be revoked.
actions.superAdminFailed: The platform change could not be completed.
actions.invalidActingUser: The acting user identifier is invalid.
actions.grantIdentityNotFound: The member, organization, or acting user could not be found.
actions.memberMustBeProduction: The member identity must belong to a production organization.
actions.targetMustBeProduction: Explicit access can only target a production organization.
actions.homeAccessAlreadyImplicit: The member already has implicit access to their home organization.
actions.actingUserMustBelongToTarget: The acting user must belong to the target organization.
actions.actingUserMustBeActive: The acting user must be active.
actions.grantCouldNotSave: The access grant could not be saved.
actions.invalidGrant: The access grant identifier is invalid.
